"Subject to the authority of the State Board under Section 2-205 (e) of this article, each county superintendent shall explain the true intent and meaning of: (i) The school law; and (ii) The applicable bylaws of the State Board."
"Subject to the provisions of Section 6-203 and Subtitle 4 of Title 6 of this article and without charge to the parties concerned, each county superintendent shall decide all controversies and disputes that involve; (i) The rules and regulars of the county board; and (ii) The proper administration of the county public school system."
"An. Code 1957, art. 77, § 160; 1978, ch 22 § 2; ch. 713, § 2; 1983, ch. 630; 1984, ch. 255."
"Education Article, Subtitle 4 of Title 6"
"The Annotated Code of Maryland"
